name: Honco Workspace
description: Honco-specific workspace features for Honco Chat: team-scoped task management, meeting recording integration, remote support workflow and Honco administration. Built as a plugin so that upstream Mattermost pulls and the idempotent de-brand scripts never collide with it.

settings_schema.header: Honco Workspace settings. Secrets configured here are stored in the Mattermost config and are never written to logs.

settings.help_text: Shared secret the Jibri finalize hook must present in the X-Jibri-Callback-Secret header. Leave blank to reject all recording callbacks.
Shared secret meetsvc.py must present in the X-Honco-Service-Secret header when registering a meeting room. Leave blank to reject all registrations.

Absolute path to a local executable that reads a conversation on stdin and writes markdown meeting notes on stdout -- the honco-summarize.sh contract. When set, this is used instead of SSH. Leave blank to reach the summarizer over SSH.
Host running the Claude summarizer behind its forced-command SSH key (the 'mother' host). Used only when Summarizer command is blank.
SSH port on the summarizer host.
SSH user on the summarizer host. Its authorized_keys entry is pinned to honco-summarize.sh by a forced command, so this account cannot be used for anything else.
Absolute path to the private key used to reach the summarizer. The key is read by ssh, never by this plugin, and is never logged.
How long to wait for a summary before giving up and marking the generation failed. Clamped to 10-900.
